entries.title: Account entry, gyro smoothing and separate flight saves
changes: Fixed hidden profile and sign-in fields, including Confirm password appearing during sign-in. Verified Google email is displayed in profile setup without another Add your email step.
Made wrong-password, taken-username, duplicate-email and password-reset progress/error feedback visible. Forgot password is available before entering a password.
Added a black fade before the loading screen and smooth spring interpolation for gyro movement.
Separated on-device flight checkpoints by account ID. Switching accounts restores that account’s checkpoint or starts at Earth; guest play does not overwrite member flights.

entries.title: Slower entry animations and stable gyro controls
changes: Slowed entry and loading transitions to 650–800 ms and preserved the entrance animation for fast sign-ins.
Centered the complete loading stack in the viewport.
Moved the Gyro Controls toggle and status into Settings > Controls, default off.
Stabilized gyro input across Euler flips and fast direction changes.
Shared the sign-in background camera with the loading screen without creating another renderer.

entries.title: Animated sign-in, scroll-to-accept rules and gyro controls
changes: Rounded sign-in controls and removed duplicate birthday choices after the entry UI is reused.
Centered loading progress inside a wider bar and added sign-in and loading transitions. Member sign-ins show account loading without reloading the page.
Added a textured 3D entry background with bounded cursor, motion-sensor and touch-drag camera rotation.
Added optional Gyro Controls for ship steering, permission handling and unsupported-device feedback.
Rules begin unchecked for first-time acceptance. Open the scrollable rules and reach the end before pressing Accept.

entries.title: Compact entry menus
changes: Smaller mobile sign-in buttons and centered title; version badge stays at the left.
Restored Google icon and added Create an account beside email sign-in.
Compact square account dialogs with centered X controls and password-aware recovery link.
Paginated official rules without scrolling or overlapping game footer styles.
Signing out returns to sign-in without refreshing the page.

entries.title: New sign-in and loading screens
changes: New Earth-horizon sign-in and loading screens with Fredoka One typography.
Google sign-in and new-player profile setup, subject to provider configuration.
Official Game Rules and required agreement before login or guest play.
Automatic game entry after loading with a black fade; studio intro retained.

entries.title: Recording duration and editor compatibility
changes: Recording exports now prefer H.264/AAC MP4 on supported browsers and finalize regular MP4 duration/sample tables before saving.
Rebuilds WebM duration and seek indexes on browsers using the compatibility format, fixing short duration labels on full-length videos.
Shows Saving video while finalizing, prevents duplicate saves, and preserves the original clip if finalization fails.

entries.title: Recorder quality, sound and pause controls
changes: Improved the draggable recording panel with Pause/Resume beside Stop and keyboard movement.
Added Frame Rate (20–60 FPS) and Resolution (360p–1080p) sliders below recording methods.
Added Record In-Game Sounds; recording respects game audio levels and includes ambience, effects and engine audio.
The one-minute recording limit and timer now exclude paused time; the red border and recording controls remain excluded from captures.

entries.title: Capture tools and early planet names
changes: Renamed primordial Mercury, Venus and the gas and ice giants to Early; Proto Earth stays unchanged and Proto Theia is now Theia.
Added System Video Recorder to More with Show GUIs / Hide GUIs options, a draggable Stop control, an elapsed timer, a screen border excluded from captures and automatic saving at the 1-minute limit.
Added matching Screenshot Method choices and close buttons to both capture menus.

entries.title: Proto Solar System and the Orion wormhole
changes: Travel through the wormhole at the center of Orion Nebula to the Proto Solar System, 4.3 billion years ago. The entrance is visible on the Universe Map; the developer-only shortcut has been removed.
Explore Proto Mercury, Venus, Earth, Theia, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune, with volcanic terrain, primordial dust and large non-landable asteroid debris.
Proto Earth has a brown-orange atmosphere, day and night without clouds or a Moon. Earth and Theia can be seen from each other.
The past has its own Universe Map. Local warps now show a confirmation and normal prices; Proto Earth and the return wormhole are free. The Orion entrance uses the normal warp price.
Return through the distant wormhole to the present beyond Neptune. Time travel includes departure, a curved tunnel and arrival scenes; the exit shrinks away after two seconds.
Proto flights save and resume on the current account. Center launch pads are available on landable Proto worlds.
Wormhole labels hide during transit, and cockpit glass now masks the wormhole horizon while keeping its transparency.
Black-hole contact restarts the flight. Airless worlds gain wider low-altitude ground coverage, and nebulae and star clusters are much larger and denser.

entries.title: Brighter stellar billboards, neon map stars and sky seam filtering
changes: 100% Bloom and Flare now use 3.2 times their previous dimensions. Independent world and map settings remain available.
Increased Bloom and Flare brightness with bounded opacity, and raised instant camera-reactive Flare rotation from 12% to 65%.
Universe Map star surfaces are fully self-lit with spectral color and Bloom only.
Wrapped sky longitude with linear base-level filtering to avoid dark mip seams, including rotating atmospheric skies.

entries.title: Transparent PNG star billboards, independent intensities and global Earth time
changes: Replaced old stellar assets with the supplied transparent Bloom and four-ray Flare PNGs. World stars use both, with spectral tint and immediate 12% camera-reactive Flare rotation; the smaller Universe Map stars use Bloom only.

Added saved World Star Bloom, Universe Map Star Bloom and World Star Flare intensity sliders. At 100%, full PNG width and height use the final requested formulas: Bloom = 1.4 times star diameter, Flare = 2 times star diameter. Bloom size and brightness scale independently by renderer.

Earth time advances away from Earth. Globe Mode freezes local day/night lighting while the global clock continues; atmospheric surface return synchronizes to current time. Only atmospheric Earth skies rotate around the Sun arc; Space, Globe and other planets do not rotate their skies.
Preserved world star/black-hole sizes, collisions, orbital positions and black-hole background audio. Shared textures and bounded alpha-preserving tint caches support PC and mobile.

entries.title: Subtle stellar effects and visible camera-reactive Shine
changes: Unified star effects in WebGL, compatibility gameplay and the Universe Map fallback: one shared Glow/Shine pair, persistent camera-reactive rotation at 12%, Shine twice the Glow dimensions and depth-aware foreground masking.
Reduced Glow/Shine intensity to 12%/8%, reduced map star emission and kept original star surfaces independent from spectral effect tints. Bounded cached tints support mobile compatibility rendering.
Reduced only the Universe Map Sun size. Preserved larger gameplay stars/black holes, existing orbit positions, Earth-only sky rotation and continuous black-hole background audio.

entries.title: Stellar effects, larger celestial visuals and rotating Earth skies
changes: Added supplied depth-tested, camera-facing Glow and Shine images to stars in flight, planetary skies and the 3D Universe Map. Shine responds instantly to horizontal and vertical camera movement at 12% rotation.
Increased visual star and black-hole sizes while preserving catalog radii, collisions, orbits and travel mechanics.
Loop the existing black-hole background throughout black-hole systems and fade through the existing audio mixer when leaving.

Earth stars and Milky Way rotate continuously with the existing day/night clock without moving Earth or changing independent Sun/Moon motion. Shared small textures replace the WebGL canvas glare pass.

entries.title: Surface and center-area performance
entries.source: Reported Earth, center and body-interior lag
changes: Bounded mobile surface shadow refreshes in ship mode and on foot with stable cached lighting.
Scanned shadow casters only in the active scene and reduced repeated discovery scans.
Reused neon occlusion results and staggered checks near detailed buildings.
Avoided repeated terrain-height samples and hidden mineral-label projections while piloting.

entries.title: Mobile on-foot performance
changes: Reduced mobile on-foot shadow map refreshes while retaining per-frame character movement and contact shadows.
Skipped detailed ship camera raycasts when the camera corridor is outside ship bounds.
Reused camera and character math objects to reduce garbage collection spikes.
Preserved desktop/ship shadow behavior, touch gestures, character poses and tool grips.

entries.title: Permanent account deletion
entries.source: Requested deletion from Supabase and Manage Accounts
changes: Permanently removed deleted Auth users and their game profiles, releasing email addresses and usernames for registration.
Revoked sessions and preserved groups for remaining members during deletion.
Removed the restore-deleted-account option from Manage Accounts.

entries.title: Animated action menus and black restart transitions
entries.source: Requested dialog, speed bar and restart fade updates
changes: Animated Credits, Help, Route, inventory, crafting, trade and purchase confirmations.
Animated group details, profile viewers and account edit/security/session/birthday/delete/deactivate menus.
Shortened the speed bar and made the Boost overlay recede from top to bottom.
Faded to black before resetting after star/core contact or Restart, with a repeated-trigger guard.

entries.title: Animated menus and relocated ship power controls
entries.source: Requested control placement and menu/message transitions
changes: Moved medium-size Boost and Warp buttons above the right ship controls.
Matched chat and Daily Rewards button height to the game title; hid the obsolete orbit zoom buttons.
Removed the CSS override that prevented Achievements motion.
Animated the message editor and image picker from below, and body information from the right.
Added scale transitions to selection menus and one-time side animations to new global, guest and party messages.

entries.title: Compact flight HUD and animated chat
entries.source: Requested flight controls, sidebar icons and chat animation fixes
changes: Changed the Universe Map action label to Set Target.
Removed legacy Security/Data pseudo-icons and used the supplied sidebar and Report artwork.
Matched Boost/Warp button height to the speed bar, fitted icons to 85%, and placed speed endpoints inside the bar.
Hid engine hold text and added a 0.65-transparent Boost timer/cooldown overlay.
Animated Achievements, emoji pickers and Global Chat, including guest chat.
Moved message editing to a smaller independent overlay above chat.

entries.title: Map buttons, mobile icons and nonblocking menus
entries.source: Reported map layout, minimap animation and image viewer fixes
changes: Fixed oversized Universe Map action icons and vertical button text.
Used supplied Minimap, Run and Jump artwork; removed the floating zoom button while preserving camera gestures.
Animated the expanded Planet Map from below and the small minimap from the right.
Allowed gameplay while Daily Rewards and Achievements are open with matching menu transitions.
Coalesced image-viewer transforms to animation frames and disabled GIF downloads.

entries.title: Single supplied icons and readable image downloads
entries.source: Live UI verification and reported duplicate Daily Rewards icon
changes: Replaced the original Daily Rewards image instead of adding a second icon, and removed duplicate legacy icon elements.
Preserved the supplied artwork colors against legacy monochrome filters.
Kept the Download label inside its image-viewer button and retained save-before-exit protection.
Enabled full stored-profile image viewing in guest profile previews as well as signed-in profiles.

entries.title: Cockpit free look, smooth menus and graphics fixes
changes: Independent 180° cockpit free look, stable seat camera, smoother capsule poses and optimized high quality rendering.
Depth-aware world labels, transparent-window neon visibility and smoother atmospheric effects.
Image download, 5 MB upload limit, group photo crop and clickable player photos.
Supplied button artwork, consistent icon fitting, mobile button transparency and simplified minimap controls.
Animated Settings, Account, Party, Achievements and expanded Minimap; graceful webpage exit; updated target and location labels.
entries.source: User-requested camera, graphics, media and UI update

entries.title: Mobile drag zoom, character poses, ground shadow and TNT prompt
changes: Added a small independent vertical-drag zoom control for simultaneous mobile movement and camera use.
Adjusted capsule proportions and leg overlap, replaced airborne leg scaling with jump/fall poses and raised both hands while falling.
Added a ground contact shadow and enlarged the third-person pickaxe while preserving its palm grip.
Added an Ignite TNT button above inventory when holding a torch within the existing five-metre ignition range.

entries.title: Character proportions, hand-driven tools, shadows and responsive following
changes: Balanced the capsule with a taller body and shorter connected legs; breathing translates the torso without changing its scale.
Moved the tool grip toward the palm edge and made action swings originate from the hand, with pickaxe cutting-plane alignment.
Removed the duplicate third-person shadow caster and eliminated delayed camera translation; character and camera share interpolated walking positions.

entries.title: Capsule proportions, held-tool grips and simultaneous mobile controls
changes: Shortened the capsule, connected animated legs to the body and added a simple line mouth.
Attached held tools and resources to the right palm using authored grip points, including upright pickaxe carry and grip-centered swings.
Added native multi-touch camera routing so swipe and pinch gestures remain independent of held movement, Run and Jump controls.

entries.title: On-foot third-person camera and Shift Lock
changes: Added independent third-person orbit, camera-relative walking, right-mouse/touch rotation, wheel/pinch zoom and automatic first-person transition.
Added an animated capsule character and camera collision avoidance on normal surfaces and the spherical experiment.
Added a saved Controls setting for optional on-foot Shift Lock, off by default, with a conditional mobile toggle.

entries.title: Player profile layout and smoother emoji picker
changes: Updated the player profile viewer with banner identity, achievement, bio and last-online cards, and friend actions.
Removed automatic emoji-search focus and spread emoji rendering across small batches to reduce opening stalls.

entries.title: Last Online in viewer local time
changes: Added Last Online to public profiles and Debug Manage Accounts, formatted in the viewing device timezone.
Preserved last activity across logout; accounts without recorded activity show Unknown.

entries.title: Compact achievements and public completion totals
changes: Centered and reduced the mobile achievements menu, sorted achievements by ascending rarity and matched the white centered achievement toggle to Account button size.
Added server-counted Total Achievements Unlocked to public player profiles, including guest viewers.

entries.title: Achievements and validated activity tracking
changes: Added 80 account achievements with compact search/filter, rarity colors, queued clickable unlock notifications and the supplied game sound.
Completed achievements automatically claim server-validated, one-time rewards totaling 100,000 FP and 10,000 RC across the full catalog.
Added persistent gameplay tracking, replay checks, resource provenance and party presence validation. Guests can browse achievements without earning progress or rewards.

entries.title: Profile identity banners and clean space spawning
changes: Profile banners sit behind the avatar, display name, username and joined date in the identity header. Bio, editing fields and actions stay outside the banner.
Mineral and trade prompts start hidden and stay hidden in space, including saved-game spawning and resource rebuilds.

entries.title: Closer cinematic shots and profile banners
changes: Cinematic framing stays near the ship at high speed, with wheel, pinch and button zoom. The sky panorama follows the camera without extra glowing star dots.
Boost and warp action buttons match the speed bar height, and the boost timer appears only while boost is active.
Profile covers unlock once for 300 RC. Choose, crop and change a wide 960 × 320 banner from Account → Profile; banners appear in the shared player viewer.

entries.title: Smoother cinematic flights and terrain visibility
changes: Airless terrain uses horizontal distance fog so ground beneath the ship stays visible while distant edges fade.
Cinematic shots change on a timer, spawn far ahead and use the saved Cinematic Camera Interval setting (5 seconds by default).
Main planet labels remain eligible beyond the old six-label limit; free camera hides ship trails immediately.
Star contact uses the visible star radius; on-foot ship contact follows model triangles, including standing on and walking beneath real hull surfaces.
Neon lights dim in bright environments and brighten smoothly in darkness.
Scrollbars are hidden while scrolling remains available, and mobile Universe Map selection and unlock panels are smaller.

entries.title: Map lock overlays and stable neon lighting
changes: Reduced chat message More buttons.
Replaced overflowing Locked text with medium lock icons on black destination button covers with 65% transparency.
Improved the Unlock System menu with clear costs, balances and prerequisite information.
Placed each Credits role and name on its own row.
Stabilized nearby neon lights, blocked light leaks behind opaque objects, improved neon depth rendering and reduced brightness in dark environments.

entries.title: System unlocks and airless Globe Mode
changes: Airless moons, dwarf planets and other eligible solid bodies switch to Globe Mode at 2,000 m and exit at 4,500 m; asteroids are excluded.
Airless worlds keep reentry audio without atmosphere or reentry visuals.
Unlock systems in order starting with Proxima Centauri and TRAPPIST-1. Prices range from 1,000 FP + 250 RC to 10,000 FP + 2,500 RC; black hole systems use the maximum.
Locked destination and route actions open an Unlock System menu. Saved flights in locked systems return to Earth.
Username changes now cost 1,000 RC; birthday changes cost 300 RC. First birthday additions remain free.
Larger centered HUD icons, Party-sized chat/rewards/minimap buttons, a 15 km aurora limit and small part-colored neon lights.

entries.title: Private birthday account settings
changes: Added private birthday settings with game month, day and year selectors.
Accounts without a birthday can add one for free; changing an existing birthday costs 500 RC after confirmation.
Validated and charged birthday changes on the server, with safe retries and cloud-save revision checks.

entries.title: Email verification spacing and readable Credits
changes: Separated email verification fields and Verify/Cancel buttons with comfortable spacing.
Displayed each credit as Role: Name, with separate Gameplay and Scripter roles.
Updated the community credit to Meowple Studios.

entries.title: Hosting credits
changes: Updated the hosting credit to Cloudflare & GitHub Pages.

entries.title: Photo editor priority and Find button alignment
changes: Kept the photo crop editor above the landscape prompt, including after returning to the browser.
Centered the Find search icon inside its horizontal button in the More menu.
Expanded Credits with world design, audio, optimization and community testing, and changed the hosting credit to Cloudflare.

entries.title: Signup, Credits and landscape menu polish
changes: Added the same image chooser and crop controls to signup as the Account menu.
Used game selection menus for birthday choices and matched birthday confirmation to the other menus.
Added login error information with red textbox and shake feedback for missing accounts and incorrect credentials.
Expanded Credits with design, scripting, UI, backend and technology roles; moved its button below Update Logs.
Kept the landscape prompt above other dialogs before and after Play and when returning to the game; removed Continue in portrait.
Shortened the More menu and restored touch scrolling in menus and the debug sidebar.

entries.title: Chat options and signup profile polish
changes: Centered the single three-dot options icon in global chat, party messages and party chat details.
Centered the signup profile image above the Profile Image label and image chooser.

entries.title: Signup page layout polish
changes: Kept the first signup page limited to profile image, display name and username.
Placed password and confirmation alongside the birthday step, followed by birthday confirmation and optional email.

entries.title: Account signup, email security and compact credits
changes: Added email or username login, a profile and birthday signup flow, birthday confirmation, optional verified email and account creation loading.
Added private email management, developer-only birthday details, and username changes for 2500 RC with confirmation and the existing 24-hour cooldown.
Fixed duplicated chat options icons and added a compact Credits menu.

entries.title: Experimental camera clearance safety
changes: Prevented radial backdrop placement from cancelling a steeply oriented ship's chase offset into the hull.
Added ship clearance after terrain camera correction, including close orbit views below the local horizon.
Added extreme-pose camera regression checks while preserving the spherical rework and all original systems.

entries.title: Sphere Test planetary rework and real WebGL verification
changes: Fixed missing experimental mobile flight controls, stale gear/boost telemetry and WASD incorrectly rotating the on-foot camera.
Rebuilt experimental terrain as one welded cube-sphere draw with balanced LOD, morph transitions and collision sampled from the actual rendered triangles.
Added parallel-transported orbital camera orientation, planet-visible space framing, smooth launch/landing attitudes and model-sized hull contact.
Preserved radial gravity with flight assist in space, circular orbit arrivals, continuous surface/space movement, and free authorized debug warp/return with restored original state.
Verified native retrograde descent, curved terrain landing, walking, launch, free return and original Globe Mode in real Chromium WebGL fixtures. Original worlds and account data remain unchanged.

entries.title: Developer-only spherical planet experiment
changes: Added an isolated Experimental System and 2 km Sphere Test with continuous cube-sphere terrain, oceans, biomes and bounded PC/mobile LOD chunks.
Added center-directed gravity, local surface walking/jumping, launch/landing, orbit flight, atmosphere, day/night lighting and the existing ship cameras and warp tunnel.
Added server-authorized debug travel and diagnostics; experimental travel costs 0 FP/RC, pauses normal progression and restores the previous location.
Kept the experimental world out of public catalogs, maps, search and normal warp destinations. Original worlds and Globe Mode are unchanged.

entries.title: Time slider fill and chat send icon fixes
changes: Synchronizes the time-of-day track immediately on time changes and programmatic refreshes, with fill aligned to the native thumb and recalculated on resize.
Removes visual fill lag and suppresses the legacy text arrow so Global Chat shows only its existing Send artwork.

entries.title: Game entry fades and profile pencil cleanup
changes: Added a black fade-out when loading finishes and when Play starts the game, allowing the scene to render before revealing it.
Repeated entry transitions replace the previous overlay and release their timers and pointer cover after completion.
Removed the duplicate inline profile-photo pencil so the existing edit button displays one icon and retains its photo-picker action.

entries.title: Landscape startup for mobile
changes: Attempts native landscape lock at startup and retries fullscreen plus landscape on the first mobile tap.
Holds the intro until landscape, pauses/resumes video across rotations, and protects sign-in/loading from portrait presentation.
Offers manual rotation when native locking is unavailable and adds the landscape preference for installed apps. Desktop startup and existing in-game orientation controls are preserved.

entries.title: Sleepy Apple Studios startup video
changes: Added the supplied studio video as the first screen on a black background, using cover cropping rather than fitting the video.
Waits one second after the video ends, then fades to the existing sign-in flow before loading game sources.
Includes browser autoplay recovery, tap-to-enable audio and a media-error fallback. Existing menus and sign-in behavior are preserved.

entries.title: HUD alignment, black-hole framing and touch slider fixes
changes: Placed Daily Rewards immediately after Global Chat, followed by the minimap toggle regardless of initialization order.
Centered minimap and icon-only controls, replaced close glyphs with centered SVG artwork, and expanded inventory buttons/previews to fill their cards.
Corrected starless map scaling so all existing black holes appear together.
Fixed collapsed slider rows, restored visible filled/unfilled slider tracks, and separated horizontal touch dragging from vertical menu scrolling.

entries.title: Map controls, distant focus and background audio fixes
changes: Centered and enlarged body-panel controls, shortened Focus, restored the game title inside the map, and aligned search with system selection.
Added Pan Speed and extended map zoom; camera-relative rendering, logarithmic depth and precision orbit arcs stabilize distant focus and keep far orbits visible.
Improved label placement, narrowed mobile Settings, and aligned slider titles, values and full-width tracks.
Environment ambience now loops through Web Audio without an HTML music player and continues while Settings is open.

entries.title: Animated map tracking, focus and atmosphere glow fixes
changes: Restored Focus on the selected body; it follows moving bodies. Universe Map title opens map quality settings and the floating Settings button is removed.
Fixed WebGL canvas resolution resets, synchronized labels and selection with animated 3D models, and preserved orbital phase when speeds change.
Reserved space for moon systems to prevent model intersections and added visible atmosphere rims plus shared-texture soft bloom for high map quality.

entries.title: Universe Map quality controls and body information
changes: Restyled the text-only body information panel with body type, radius, gravity and temperature when available; removed visible zoom buttons and narrowed search.
Added persistent Universe Map quality controls for resolution, body detail, bloom/glow, orbit and skybox resolution, zoom limits, animation speeds, visibility and label size.
Added an always-accessible Settings button and optional slow parent-relative map orbits without changing gameplay positions.
Fixed texture loading beyond the first twenty bodies and added procedural rocky fallback maps for bodies without artwork. High quality supports atmosphere glow and star shine.

entries.title: Map body-info panel and picker layout fixes
changes: Moved selected-body information and map controls into a right-side panel with description and close button; selecting body labels now works.
Replaced uniform orbit gaps with compressed catalog-distance spacing, giving outer planets visibly larger gaps.
Centered emoji choices, restored GIF preview sizing and inset the Planet Map title/close header.
Moved the Universe Map heading upward and kept zoom controls separate from the selected-body panel.

entries.title: UI transparency, map search and menu fixes
changes: Preserved transparent surfaces while applying main interface colors to painted panels and top bars.
Restored body-name search results, removed the All systems selector option and added system-changing text to the black fade.
Restored labeled Help in More and matched main action button sizes to the account button.
Restored the sign-in screen loading background and rocket pattern.

entries.title: Map clarity and consistent game UI
changes: Improved distant sphere detail, widened orbital spacing and added distinct visible moon orbits.
Added irregular asteroid models, black-hole accretion disks and 3D galaxy/nebula details, with a Milky Way skybox.
Removed the map compass and reduced selected-body information to its name and destination/route buttons. Search focus no longer opens the body list.
Unified interface colors with the main cyan/white HUD, squared icon-only controls and bundled the original Fredoka One font.

entries.title: Full-screen 3D Universe Map
changes: Reworked the Universe Map into a full-screen textured 3D view with rings, atmospheres, orbital paths, readable labels and a compass.
Added direct 3D body selection, smooth focus and camera movement, Orbits/Labels toggles and black fades when changing systems.
Removed Universe Map Size; retained search, system selection, destination locking and route planning.
Added model LOD, bounded texture uploads, closed-map render suspension and resource cleanup.

entries.title: Cinematic camera distance fix
changes: Bound cinematic camera placement using ship size and speed so shots stay wide without losing the ship.
Refresh cinematic shots before the ship crosses the maximum distance; keep ship movement and velocity untouched.

entries.title: Cinematic flybys, space speed and atmosphere flares
changes: Camera button cycles Chase, Cockpit, Orbit and Flyby – Cinematic. Removed Planet Aligned and Space Aligned orbit choices.
Cinematic shots hold fixed world positions, track the ship center and repeat ahead of its flight path with smooth camera transitions. Ship movement and velocity are preserved.
Normal space speed is capped at 50c and boosted space speed at 100c. Existing atmospheric caps, acceleration, boost duration and cooldown are unchanged.
Added smooth orange-red exit flares from 1,800m to 5,000m without nose shine, with speed and airflow response. Smoothed entry flare transitions and disabled camera shake during cinematic shots.

entries.title: High-speed ship camera fixes
changes: Camera switches now follow the moving ship instead of pulling the view toward its previous world position.
Cinematic flyby uses a moving shot when a single frame would carry the ship past the stationary camera, while slower flybys keep stationary shots.
Flyby replacement shots refresh when the ship outruns their destination.

entries.title: Planet and space orbit cameras, cinematic flyby and larger stars
changes: Added independently rotatable Planet Aligned and Space Aligned ship orbit cameras with existing wheel/pinch zoom.
Added stationary world-space cinematic flyby shots with smooth speed-adaptive repositioning and camera clearance.
Added camera choices to the existing selector and Settings Controls, preserving legacy camera shortcuts and warp restrictions.
Narrowed Settings and added mouse-wheel scrolling to the hidden-scrollbar navigation rail.
Enlarged visible star spheres in space and surface skies without changing catalog radii, orbital coordinates or existing shine scaling.

entries.title: Compact mobile settings and consistent label filters
changes: Reduced mobile header, tabs and section heights and hid the horizontal tab scrollbar.
Combined Quality settings on one page without Display, World or Map sub-tabs.
Applied label filters to locked targets as well as ordinary labels and persisted category switches on this device.

entries.title: Cyan tabbed settings menu
changes: Redesigned settings with cyan panels, category tabs, collapsible sections, styled switches and a fixed action footer.
Organized existing world, quality, menu sizing, control and audio settings without replacing their saved values or handlers.
Added linked graphics preset buttons and a keyboard control reference, with responsive mobile layouts.
Corrected switch thumb alignment in both states.
Embedded Update Logs as a Settings tab with the shared header and footer.

entries.title: Earth-only day/night and balanced ambience
changes: Limited day/night background to Earth; airless bodies use other-bodies ambience at every altitude.
Used reentry background throughout gas-giant interiors and above 1000m on other atmospheric worlds.
Reduced background output to 20% of its previous level at the same settings, with a 100% default background slider for new preferences.
Raised plasma-gated wind to a clearer level without enabling continuous wind.

entries.title: Effect-gated wind and fading nighttime aurora
changes: Removed continuous altitude-triggered wind; quieter wind plays only while reentry plasma is active.
Kept background tracks looped independently of the wind effect.
Hid daytime aurora and added smooth 1.5-second fade-in and fade-out transitions at nightfall and daybreak.

entries.title: Correct background tracks and louder looped reentry wind
changes: Used the supplied horror ambience as the looped reentry background and supplied space ambience as the looped other-bodies background.
Played reentry above 1000m on all bodies, day/night below 1000m on atmospheric worlds, and other-bodies ambience below 1000m on airless worlds.
Added a louder separately looped wind layer alongside the reentry background.

entries.title: Looped altitude audio and faster surface sun glow
changes: Kept ground ambience below 1000m and used a looped reentry rumble above it on atmospheric bodies only.
Moved surface star glow to depth-tested GPU sprites, removing CPU triangle masking and raycasts when looking at the sun.

entries.title: Star rendering and environment audio
changes: Reduced star glow masking work to nearby foreground silhouettes.
Removed angular twisting from the ship-aligned reentry flare.
Added six environment background tracks with volume controls for ambience, weather, airflow, engine and individual effects.
Saved audio preferences and stopped background audio when the game loses focus.

entries.title: Precise nose alignment and instant world-space warp fog
changes: Anchored flare and shine directly to the authored ship nose instead of the camera subject center or bounding box.
Kept the flare on the visible model centerline while allowing shine to face the camera through every direction.
Showed the complete interstellar tunnel immediately and added fixed world-space glowing fog layers to cover its distant edge.

entries.title: Centered entry shine and brighter warp travel
changes: Centered entry flare and shine on the authored ship nose, with horizontal camera-facing shine and translucent plasma below 3600 m.
Scaled stellar shine with apparent star size and distance.
Made warps last 10 seconds and brightened the Milky Way tunnel, stars and neon rim with white entry and exit fades.

entries.title: Curved Milky Way warp and precise stellar shine
changes: Used a glowing sun inside bodies and the supplied star shine in space, with exact ship and ring occlusion instead of bounding boxes.
Wrapped the Milky Way continuously around a curved tunnel and aligned the ship and chase camera to its tangent.
Restored blue warp lines below 20 percent, above 80 percent and during same-system warps.
Centered entry flames using the unrotated flight model and placed a wider ship-facing shine at the cone tip.
Extended the globe flight band from 4000 m to 6500 m, giving 2500 m before space.

entries.title: Skybox-only warp and ship-aligned entry flames
changes: Removed glowing sticks and filaments from the warp tunnel, leaving the wrapped current skybox and its glow.
Limited entry flames to inward travel and disabled them while taking off.
Aligned symmetric flames and the forward-offset shine to ship pitch, yaw and roll, with orange, red, yellow and white colors.
Added a separate four-point color-tinted star shine in space.

entries.title: Skybox warp, staged reentry and stellar shines
changes: Replaced tunnel circles with stretched current-system skybox textures, flowing cyan and violet filaments, and fast light streaks.
Added animated ground-facing reentry flares and the supplied horizontal shine, with gradual brightness and size changes during entry and exit.
Made the globe atmosphere glow around its curved silhouette.
Replaced the old layered star shines with the supplied eight-point shine, tinted by each star color.
Raised the active space boost limit from 100c to 200c while retaining the normal 100c limit.

entries.title: Enclosed vortex tunnel and taller aurora rays
changes: Extended the visibly lit aurora rays beyond 250 m by lengthening the veil and softening its upper fade, while preserving Center Station ovals and arc animation.
Remade the tunnel with opaque blue/violet vortex walls, cyan/white filaments, fast streaks and a glowing closed far portal using the supplied image as reference.
Excluded exterior planets, sky, stars and glare from the tunnel render pass, with exception-safe restoration after rendering.
Hid world labels and the target reticle only during the tunnel phase, restoring them after exit or cancellation.
Matched the enclosed vortex and foreground ship drawing in Canvas compatibility mode; retained pooled corridor geometry and lower graphics budgets.

entries.title: Nearby warp protection, world corridor and Center aurora
changes: Rejected warp both near the departure body and when already close to the selected destination. Rechecked before confirmation and payment, including saved viewpoint travel.
Hid the minimap toggle when no usable solid-body minimap is available.
Capped every warp at ten seconds while retaining seven-second local journeys.

Replaced the camera-attached tunnel with a ship-transit corridor using a fixed journey axis, fast travel and four recycled world sections with white neon ribs and edges. Updated compatibility projection.
Selected chase camera for warp and locked camera/free/orbit mode changes until completion or cancellation.

Remade the aurora above Center Station as three animated wavy ovals that gradually open into arcs, with green, cyan, blue and magenta bands inspired by the supplied image. Retained pooled textures and geometry.

entries.title: Soft natural aurora veils
changes: Reworked aurora appearance using NASA ground-photo and aurora references: green-dominant light, subtle pink/violet accents, uneven fine rays and soft upper tails.
Replaced repeating sine stripes with a seeded translucent veil texture whose four edges fade fully away.
Separated the three gently curved curtains so they no longer intersect as bright flat panels. Retained the compact vertical height near 4 km.
Shared the same aurora artwork between WebGL and Canvas compatibility rendering, with slow deformation and brightness changes.
Generated the 512 × 128 texture once and reused the texture, canvas and bounded geometry during animation.

entries.title: Aurora curtains, staged interstellar warp and distant villages
changes: Replaced circular aurora walls with three broad flowing curtains near 4000 m, reduced their vertical height and added varied green, cyan, blue, violet and pink/red palettes. Updated the compatibility renderer to match.
Centered the square map itself in its menu and corrected the CSS specificity that overrode its width and margins. Kept zoom buttons outside on the right.
Blocked warp near physical bodies before confirmation or payment, preserving velocity and funds when rejected.
Added an interstellar tunnel that opens after 20% progress, fades closed by 85% and returns to light-beam travel. Local warp retains its beam effect.
Scaled interstellar journey duration with displayed light-year distance while preserving cancellation and existing arrival behavior.

Extended village generation beyond the original 2 km area with deterministic sparse world regions, bounded descriptor caching and nearby-only loading. Preserved original village IDs, discovery, doors and removed blocks.
Limited minimap roof generation to the viewed area and reused effect geometry, with reduced streak counts on mobile and lower graphics.

entries.title: Centered map zoom controls and compact circular range
changes: Centered the + / − column in the full space between the square map and the right menu border.
Set circular minimap coverage to 86 × 86 m when stationary and 115 × 115 m while moving, with smooth interpolation at every altitude.

entries.title: Live map buildings and natural biome placement
changes: Moved + / − zoom buttons outside the square map, in a separate right-side column.
Increased movement-based circular map zoom out and capped map coverage at 1966 × 1966 m.
Scattered biome centers more widely, varied their outlines and blended across former grid boundaries while retaining the launch-area plains.
Displayed the actual biome name when selecting its icon.
Restricted Gold and Emerald deposits to open village spaces while preserving mineral identities, inventory and mined-state saves.

Added overhead roads, station buildings, village roofs and player-built blocks to both map views. Checked structure revisions every frame, refreshed changed buildings immediately and retained destroyed blocks after villages unload.
Preserved existing village identities and player edits across the biome generation change.

entries.title: Minimap zoom and navigation lock
changes: Fixed the question-mark button so clicking it again closes the map menu.
Added right-middle + and − buttons with smooth bounded map zoom.
Added Lock To Navigation to follow the blue player arrow; dragging the map unlocks following.
Added subtle circular minimap zoom out while moving and zoom in while stationary.
Kept map controls responsive while Settings pauses gameplay.

entries.title: Smooth minimaps and a nonmodal planet map
changes: Moved coordinates, altitude, biome, planet information and the icon guide into a centered map menu, leaving a smaller circular HUD map and a bottom-right question-mark button.
Added a square 96 × 96 m map that pans with mouse or touch, keeps one terrain raster, marks Center Station at the edge and shows place names when selected. Panning does not generate gameplay terrain.
Kept the map menu nonmodal so gameplay, Settings, Account and other visible controls remain usable. Added an X close button and map-click toggle.
Avoided guest notices and right-side flight/walking controls at different minimap sizes, moving the HUD left when necessary.
Rendered map heading and positions every frame and scrolled cached terrain continuously in world coordinates.
Updated enabled shadows every rendered frame on PC and mobile, retained existing map resolutions and moved the shadow light with its stabilized target. Scene-caster discovery remains cached.

entries.title: Compact planet minimap and world updates
changes: Added a compact circular planet minimap beside Global Chat with direction labels, player heading, XYZ, altitude, current biome, planet preview and Center Station distance and edge arrow. Added landmarks for villages, trade and craft centers, launch pads, towers and biomes.
Added Minimap Menu Size in Settings and placement below the top controls with guest banner clearance. Hidden the map in space and gas interiors.
Expanded Earth aurora around 4,000m for ground and globe views. Extended wind-driven clouds across multiple terrain chunks using the existing mesh pool.
Limited ship speed to 100c, including boost.
Added a single gray ring to Quaoar and Haumea and icy blue rings to Proxima c. Enabled harvesting alien trees.
Added developer-only total and online guest counts and replaced username deletion confirmation with a checkbox tied to the selected account UID. Requires the account maintenance SQL.

Prepared a SQL migration to remove unverified email registrations after five hours on the next minute tick, protecting verified, recent, anonymous, phone, OAuth and developer accounts. Live database installation is separate.

entries.title: Corrected globe motion, streamed clouds and alien scenery
changes: Corrected globe travel direction, retained the actual entry latitude and carried travelled globe geography into space exit. Orbital flight now reaches 500 m/s, with a smooth cap increase from 3,500m to 4,000m.
Opened high-altitude arrivals directly in globe mode, removing the brief ground-view flash and second transition.
Used the same selected surface texture as each ordinary planet ball. Removed the forced Pacific orientation and duplicate Earth cloud overlay; the default Earth launch site sits on mapped land.
Matched non-Earth terrain and atmosphere color families to representative colors sampled from the bundled artwork.
Attached cloud ownership to generated terrain chunks. Clouds drift and fade within their chunks, despawn with unloaded terrain and reuse a fixed mesh pool on newly generated terrain.
Added low-poly alien trees to exoplanet and simulated-planet scenery batches without adding separate tree draw calls or changing resource rewards.
Replaced the first-person shadow caster with one capsule, preserving the Global Shadow setting.
Changed update-log titles and entries to neutral release wording such as Added and Fixed.

entries.title: Body-colored atmospheres and clearer moving globes
changes: Matched sky, fog, clouds and orbital rim colors per world, including Mars. Added artistic atmospheres for Io, TRAPPIST-1 e/f/g and simulated solid worlds.
Covered lower terrain and clouds with dense altitude fog before the black-covered globe swap. Globe surfaces use their own bundled textures without ground fog or full-disk transparent haze.

Added silhouette-only atmospheric glow, independent wind-driven clouds composited into the opaque globe and slow reversible surface movement based on ship travel. Earth daylight pauses in globe mode and space.
Clipped high-speed white wing trails once at each tail instead of folding old endpoints. Atmospheric exits leave camera clearance outside the ordinary planet ball.
Hide both Land buttons when landing is unavailable; preserve the 800m guard. Removed the free-camera plus/minus buttons while retaining sliders, wheel and keyboard controls.
Added bounded textured globe rendering for the 2D fallback and PC/mobile regression coverage. Native GPU appearance and physical-device frame rates remain unverified.

entries.title: Close Earth horizon and hidden terrain swaps
changes: Added a separate close Earth view with a blue atmospheric limb and Earth ocean/continent texture, leaving normal space planet materials unchanged.
Replaced the terrain/globe dissolve with a short black-screen fade above 4,000m and on return below 3,900m. No globe or backing sphere is shown from the ground.
Extended distant ground to a 60km radius with one mesh under 2,500 vertices, preserving detailed terrain and scenery budgets.

entries.title: Fixed glowing planets and camera-following clouds
changes: Made atmospheric haze follow star lighting and limited its radiance to the existing lit surface brightness, preventing planets from self-glowing in space.
Removed camera/player offsets from cloud positions. Clouds keep fixed world coordinates and drift only with wind.
Replaced the compatibility renderer’s screen-following Earth clouds with the same projected world-space cloud positions, keeping day/night tint and weather opacity.

entries.title: Unified atmospheric fog and the planet transition
changes: Made the globe and opaque ground shell obey the same distance fog as terrain, so they cannot bypass fog layers.
Added shared spherical atmospheric extinction and haze to surface and space planet rendering. Lower atmosphere remains visible when looking downward, even after the overhead sky darkens.
Replaced the early black fog tint and abrupt horizon clearing with continuous altitude-dependent fog ranges and a horizon that fades with the 4,000–5,000m terrain transition.
Removed the unfogged legacy atmosphere halo and matched haze colors, weather density and physical scale across local and space rendering. Mobile uses fewer atmospheric samples.

entries.title: Fixed the nearby Earth transition and intensified reentry
changes: Moved the terrain-to-planet blend to 4,000–5,000m while keeping the sky fade complete by 3,000m.
Enlarged the near-planet horizon and matched the space boundary so Earth remains close at atmospheric exit. An opaque ground shell seals terrain gaps during the blend.
Intensified airflow-facing plasma, added a compressed bow shock on desktop Ultra/Ultra+, lengthened fiery streaks and added turbulent ember movement. Low/Medium and mobile retain bounded effects.
Made reentry shake roughly four times stronger on PC, with stronger mobile shake, while retaining smooth fades and independent camera rotation and zoom.

entries.title: Fixed loading stuck at zero
changes: Let Guest and successful login continue loading immediately while slow account connection checks finish independently. Late account responses cannot replace the selected mode.
Show manifest loading progress immediately and display a Retry button if the loader itself cannot load, without clearing saved progress.

entries.title: Extended atmospheres and improved reentry
changes: Extended atmospheric flight to 5,000m, faded the sky by 3,000m and blended terrain into a spherical planet visible from 4,000m.
Set entry speed to 50 m/s and the upper atmosphere cap to 100 m/s, with a 450 m/s lower maximum and smooth cap transitions. Landing still requires descending below 800m.
Added orange-red airflow-facing heat shields, animated plasma, sparks and fiery streaks. Reentry peaks at 1,500–1,000m, fades to 800m and causes no damage.
Smoothed reentry and weaker ascent shake across all ship cameras, preserving rotation and zoom.
Added subtle heat distortion on High and above, richer Ultra/Ultra+ glow, bounded mobile particle budgets and preserved white space wing trails.

entries.title: Improved graphics and atmospheric flight
changes: Added 2,500m solid-world atmospheres, a 200 m/s upper band and a 450 m/s lower maximum with smooth cap transitions. Entry and exit retain control and momentum.
Added airflow-facing plasma, wind and subtle camera shake. Plasma peaks at 1,500–1,000m, fades to 800m and stays off below it. Exit effects are weaker, and reentry causes no damage.
Require atmospheric ships to descend below 800m before Land can engage. Airless landing remains available.
Added white wingtip trails in space, longer and brighter while boosting, with an independent saved Settings toggle. The ship model is unchanged.
Added planet micro-relief, sharper map sampling, soft cloud billows, star twinkle, richer black-hole bands and Ultra highlight/shadow improvements, with bounded mobile/Low budgets.

entries.title: Made menus compact and fixed portrait controls

Separated Run Button Size from Jump Button Size, matched the Gift and Global Chat icons, and spaced Guest, Continue and sign-in actions.
Gave portrait mode compact HUD and separate steering, thrust and speed-gauge areas, and refresh the canvas after orientation/fullscreen/viewport changes.

Added public Online/Offline status and refreshed player profiles, plus Guest Mode help.
Moved Daily Rewards to a gift icon left of Global Chat, with a ready badge and one message sound per available daily reward.
Centered and compacted the reward menu, added currency/item icons, and added building supplies throughout the week, including 64 TNT on Day 7. Server claims remain atomic and safe to retry.

Added a 100 RC confirmation before entering Free Camera. Canceling does not spend anything.

Stopped menu opening and button clicks from playing the same UI sound twice.
